title: Vinod Kumar Varshney v. State of U.P. and others
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.; Vikram D. Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; arrears relegated to Clause 6.5; theft assessment left pending.
headnote: The High Court will not quash a proposed theft-assessment notice where the final order is still pending and the licensee undertakes to consider the consumer's objections at that stage, nor a demand for electricity arrears when Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 supplies objections before the Executive Engineer. The writ is disposed of with that liberty.
facts: Vinod Kumar Varshney filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court seeking quashing of two electricity-department notices. The notice dated 6 May 2022 proposed assessment of Rs. 5,07,494 for alleged theft of electricity and invited objections within fifteen days; the petitioner said he had already objected. The notice dated 11 May 2022 demanded arrears of Rs. 1,44,758.56. Counsel for the department stated that the final theft-assessment order had not yet been passed.

holding_units.topic: disputed electricity arrears — objections to Executive Engineer
holding_units.holding: A demand for electricity arrears, if disputed, is to be objected to before the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the writ court will not quash such a notice. A proposed theft-assessment notice likewise requires no writ direction where the final assessment has not been passed and the licensee states that already-filed objections will be considered then.

principle_tags.application: The Court refused a writ quashing the 11 May 2022 arrears demand and left the petitioner to objections before the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5.
Disputed electricity dues of Rs. 1,44,758.56 were treated as a Clause 6.5 matter, not a writ controversy.
The statutory forum named for the arrears dispute is the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5.

not_decided.point: Validity of the proposed theft assessment of Rs. 5,07,494
not_decided.note: Final assessment order not yet passed; objections to be considered at that stage.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the arrears demand of Rs. 1,44,758.56
not_decided.note: Petitioner relegated to Clause 6.5 objections before the Executive Engineer.
